newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB says M0 grew 4.3 pct in August vs Q4 1995.
newsitem.headline: SNB says M0 grew 4.3 pct in August vs Q4 1995.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said that its key monetary aggregate M0 grew by a seasonally adjusted 4.3 percent in August versus the fourth quarter of 1995, to 31.538 billion Swiss francs.
On an annualised basis the rate of growth in August was 5.7 percent, the SNB said in an advance release of its monthly report.
In August the SNB said M0 grew on a sesonally adjusted basis by 3.0 percent versus the fourth quarter, and by 4.5 percent if calculated on an annual basis.
Sight deposits in August averaged 3.214 billion francs, an increase of 471 million. Notes in circulation rose by 2.2 percent versus the previous month to an average level of 27.756 billion francs.
M0 comprises banks' sight deposits at the SNB plus notes in circulation.
